cards.target: Ci chiamiamo spesso.
cards.english: We call each other often.

cards.target: Non scrivere sul muro!
cards.english: Don't write on the wall!

cards.target: Ti alzi sempre tardi.
cards.english: You always get up late.

cards.target: Quando siamo usciti, pioveva.
cards.english: As we were going out, it was raining.

cards.target: Si diverte con gli amici.
cards.english: She has fun with friends.

cards.target: Ci addormentiamo guardando la TV.
cards.english: We fall asleep watching TV.

cards.target: Grazie per il tuo aiuto.
cards.english: Thank you for your help.

cards.target: Ascolta quello che ti dico.
cards.english: Listen to what I'm telling you.

cards.target: Ci prepariamo per la festa.
cards.english: We get ready for the party.

cards.target: Si prepara in venti minuti.
cards.english: She gets ready in twenty minutes.

cards.target: Ci cambiamo prima di uscire.
cards.english: We get changed before going out.

cards.target: Vuole rilassarsi dopo il lavoro.
cards.english: He wants to relax after work.

cards.target: Si abitua alla nuova città.
cards.english: She gets used to the new city.

cards.target: Da lontano sembra una stella.
cards.english: From far away it looks like a star.

cards.target: Vorrei iscrivermi a un corso.
cards.english: I would like to sign up for a course.

cards.target: Ti fai la barba ogni mattina?
cards.english: Do you shave every morning?

cards.target: Si sono trasferiti in un'altra città.
cards.english: They moved to another city.

cards.target: Mi faccio la doccia ogni sera.
cards.english: I take a shower every evening.

cards.target: Il libro che leggo è interessante.
cards.english: The book I'm reading is interesting.

cards.target: Mi sveglio alle sette ogni mattina.
cards.english: I wake up at seven every morning.

cards.target: Si alza presto anche la domenica.
cards.english: She gets up early even on Sundays.

cards.target: Mi sono perso nel centro storico.
cards.english: I got lost in the old town.

cards.target: Per piacere, mi passi il sale?
cards.english: Could you please pass me the salt?

cards.target: Quando ero piccola, avevo un gatto.
cards.english: When I was little, I had a cat.

cards.target: Pioveva e lei ha dimenticato l'ombrello.
cards.english: It was raining and she forgot the umbrella.

cards.target: Da voi fa freddo in inverno?
cards.english: Is it cold where you are in winter?

cards.target: È importante che i bambini dormano abbastanza.
cards.english: It's important that children sleep enough.

cards.target: Ero stanco ma ho continuato a lavorare.
cards.english: I was tired but I kept working.

cards.target: Spero che il dottore mi dia buone notizie.
cards.english: I hope the doctor gives me good news.

cards.target: È importante che l'albergo offra un buon servizio.
cards.english: It's important that the hotel offer good service.

cards.target: Quando ho finito il lavoro, erano già le otto.
cards.english: When I finished work, it was already eight.

cards.target: Mentre guardavamo il film, si è spenta la TV.
cards.english: While we were watching the movie, the TV turned off.

cards.target: Mi annoiavo e così sono uscito a fare una passeggiata.
cards.english: I was bored so I went out for a walk.

cards.target: Quando l'ho visto, piangeva.
cards.english: When I saw him, he was crying.

cards.target: Ti trucchi ogni mattina?
cards.english: Do you put on makeup every morning?

cards.target: Parlale con calma e gentilezza.
cards.english: Talk to her calmly and kindly.

cards.target: Lavoro per una grande azienda.
cards.english: I work for a big company.

cards.target: Quando siamo arrivati, pioveva forte.
cards.english: When we arrived, it was raining hard.

cards.target: Si prepara velocemente la mattina.
cards.english: He gets ready quickly in the morning.

cards.target: Mentre passeggiavamo, abbiamo incontrato Luigi.
cards.english: While we were walking, we ran into Luigi.

cards.target: Si è sentita male al concerto.
cards.english: She felt sick at the concert.

cards.target: Bisogna che qualcuno controlli le prenotazioni.
cards.english: Someone needs to check the reservations.

cards.target: Mentre camminavamo, abbiamo visto un arcobaleno.
cards.english: While we were walking, we saw a rainbow.

cards.target: Mentre correva, è inciampato e caduto.
cards.english: While he was running, he tripped and fell.

cards.target: Scriva il suo indirizzo su questo modulo.
cards.english: Write your address on this form.

cards.target: Si lava le mani prima di mangiare.
cards.english: He washes his hands before eating.

cards.target: Dubito che il prezzo includa la colazione.
cards.english: I doubt the price includes breakfast.

cards.target: Sembra che il ristorante abbia cambiato proprietario.
cards.english: It seems the restaurant changed owners.

cards.target: Ho comprato un libro per mia madre.
cards.english: I bought a book for my mother.

cards.target: È possibile che l'hotel sia al completo.
cards.english: It's possible the hotel is fully booked.

cards.target: Pensavo a te quando mi hai scritto.
cards.english: I was thinking about you when you texted me.

cards.target: Bisogna che qualcuno vada a fare la spesa.
cards.english: Someone needs to go grocery shopping.

cards.target: Sembra che il ristorante abbia cambiato il menù.
cards.english: It seems the restaurant changed its menu.

cards.target: Mi lavo i denti tre volte al giorno.
cards.english: I brush my teeth three times a day.

cards.target: Non stavo bene ma sono andato al lavoro.
cards.english: I wasn't feeling well but I went to work.

cards.target: Qualunque piatto tu ordini in quel ristorante, sarà buono.
cards.english: Whatever dish you order at that restaurant, it'll be good.

cards.target: Camminavo per strada e all'improvviso ho sentito il mio nome.
cards.english: I was walking down the street and suddenly I heard my name.

cards.target: Mentre guidava, si è fermata la macchina.
cards.english: While she was driving, the car stopped.

cards.target: Guidavo tranquillo e all'improvviso un cervo ha attraversato.
cards.english: I was driving calmly and suddenly a deer crossed.

cards.target: Mentre facevo la doccia, è andata via la luce.
cards.english: While I was showering, the power went out.

existing_tips: Italian object pronouns go before the verb: 'lo vedo' (I see him/it), 'gli parlo' (I talk to him). T
Reflexive verbs use reflexive pronouns (mi, ti, si, ci, vi, si) before the conjugated verb: "Mi sveg
"Da" = from/since/at someone's place. "Da tre anni" (for three years), "dal dottore" (at the doctor'
Passato prossimo (siamo usciti) for event + imperfetto (faceva) for weather.
Verbs of opinion, hope, doubt, or perception + "che" require the subjunctive mood.
"Volere che" + congiuntivo: expressing a wish about someone else's action. The subjunctive is mandat
Indefinite pronouns/adjectives (qualunque, chiunque, ovunque) take the subjunctive in formal usage.
Imperfetto progressivo (stavo leggendo) for background + passato prossimo (è caduta) for sudden even
`È necessario che`, `bisogna che`, `è importante che` → next verb in congiuntivo. The trigger phrase
'Lui' = he (subject). The verb ending (-a for third person -are, -e for -ere/-ire) already shows the
Passato prossimo (l'ho incontrata) for event + imperfetto (portava) for description.
The subjunctive form appears after "che" – triggered by the main clause expressing opinion, wish, do
